report.explanation: All current read-only telemetry is healthy: gateway checkout span OK at 67ms, error_rate 0.0014, p95 79ms, zero dependency timeouts and db pool waiters across gateway/order/payment/inventory, and INFO 200 logs. The gateway deployment record (3.0.0, 500 min old, valid config) cannot establish deployment-caused latency. No evidence supports any public cause; the alert is contradicted by observations, so hand off rather than assert a root cause.
missing_evidence: Telemetry showing actual checkout degradation (elevated error rate or p95 latency) in the alert window; current traces/metrics/logs show healthy OK/200 responses.
Per-service latency and error breakdown across gateway, order, payment, inventory to localize any real fault.
Evidence of dependency timeouts, db pool waiters, or resource saturation if a specific cause is suspected.
